title: AstroQuest back in the catalog
items: Restored evertec82/AstroQuest to Games & Emulation. It had answered 404 from three independent checks — the GitHub API, shields.io and a signed-in browser — and was removed; it answers again, so the card is back.

Its release badge now reads v0.8.6 (Game 1.04 soccer timing fix, 2026-10-14). Every other catalogued repo was re-checked the same way: 54 of 54 are present, none renamed, transferred, archived or gone.
